휘둘리다.englishExpression: be swayed; be swept; be lost

휘둘리다.definitionKo: 충격을 받거나 병이 들어 몸을 가누지 못하다.
휘둘리다.englishDescription: To be unable to keep oneself steady from shock or illness.

휴경지.definitionKo: 예전에 농사를 짓다가 지금은 농사를 짓지 않고 내버려 둔 땅.
휴경지.englishDescription: Land that used to be plowed for farming, but is now left uncultivated.
휴경지.englishExpression: land not in use; fallow land

흘끗대다.englishDescription: To look sideways at something furtively, repeatedly.
흘끗대다.englishExpression: keep looking sideways; keep leering at

흘려보내다.englishDescription: To let something pass or go by.

흘려보내다.definitionKo: 주의해서 듣지 않고 그냥 지나쳐 버리다.
흘려보내다.englishDescription: To miss or forget what others say without paying attention to it.

흘리-.variant: 흘리고, 흘리는데, 흘리니, 흘리면, 흘리는, 흘린, 흘릴, 흘립니다

흘림.definitionKo: 글자를 흘려 써서 획의 생략과 연결이 심한 서체.
흘림.englishDescription: A style of handwriting, not drawing every stroke, in which individual words are freely written using a single continuous motion of the pen.

흡인.englishDescription: An act of sucking or attracting something.

흥행하다.definitionKo: 돈을 받고 연극이나 영화 등을 사람들에게 보여 주다.
흥행하다.englishDescription: To show a play or movie to the audience in return for money.

흥행하다.definitionKo: 연극이나 영화 등의 공연이 상업적으로 큰 수익을 거두다.
흥행하다.englishDescription: For a performance or show such as a play, movie, etc., to make a big profit commercially.
흥행하다.englishExpression: be a box office hit; be a box office success

흰색.englishDescription: The color of snow or milk.

힐끗거리다.englishDescription: To look at something briefly, repeatedly.
For something to come in and out of view repeatedly.

힘줄.definitionKo: 근육을 이루는 희고 질긴 살의 줄.
힘줄.englishDescription: A cord of tough, white tissue, which comprises a muscle.
